title: PCSO Lotto Result: Lone 6/42 Lotto bettor from Bulacan wins P94.813 million jackpot
summary: A lone Lotto 6/42 bettor is P94.813 million richer, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes announced Tuesday evening.

blocks.text: A lone Lotto 6/42 bettor is P94.813 million richer, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes announced Tuesday evening.
The winning combination of 42-05-15-26-19-40 yielded a prize of P94,813,839.57 for the lucky bettor.
PCSO said the winning ticket was purchased from an outlet in Bulacan.
The odds of winning the jackpot in Lotto 6/42 are 1 in 5,245,786 for a standard six-number ticket.
Meanwhile, no one won in the other major lotto jackpot draws.
The Ultra Lotto 6/58 jackpot of P392,060,109.64 was left untouched after no one chose the numbers of 35-49-26-12-10-57.
For Superlotto 6/49, the correct combination of 04-46-36-40-22-20, would have meant a prize of P46,413,143.33.
